title: D-RCV-36 T1 and T2 text is not in the source documents read for this work package
source: 22 Microservice Realignment/Recovery Workbench Microservice Story Template and Rules v1.md
description: ADR-017 is required to amend D-RCV-36 T1 and T2. The Temporal and Drools Change Register v1 that holds the T1 to T10 wording is not in the read list of this work package, and the two Temporal and Drools extract files cite T1 and T2 only in passing. ADR-017 therefore records the amendment by reference to the §R8.4 mapping instead of restating the T1 and T2 text.
evidence: Template and Rules v1 §R8.4: '017 | Embedded Drools per service; rule registry in rwb-decision - amends D-RCV-36 T1 and T2'. Recovery Workbench Temporal and Drools Design Text Extract v1 slide 2 note names 'the Temporal and Drools Change Register v1 (decisions T1 to T10, D-RCV-36)' as the source, which is not in the read list.
proposed: Add the T1 and T2 text from the Temporal and Drools Change Register v1 to ADR-017 when the register is available; until then the amendment stands by reference.

title: Three Temporal release positions disagree: 1.28.1 in ADR-011, 1.29.7 in the design stack note, 1.30+ required for Nexus and Worker Versioning
source: 05 Technical architecture/Recovery Workbench Architecture Decision Records v3.md; 22 Microservice Realignment/Recovery Workbench Architecture v5 Text Extract v1.md; 22 Microservice Realignment/Recovery Workbench Temporal and Drools Design Text Extract v1.md
section: ADR-011 Decision bullet 1; Architecture v5 slides 23, 24 and 47; Temporal and Drools design slide 12 and slide 32 note
description: ADR-011 sets the cluster on 'the pinned release SCB IT approves at build' and its consequence names 1.28.1. Architecture v5 slide 23 requires version 1.30+ for Nexus and Worker Versioning and slide 47 lists the upgrade from 1.28.1 as a Wave 0 risk. The Temporal and Drools design notes a local stack of 1.29.7. ADR-016 states 1.30 or later on the pinned release SCB IT approves at build, and the exact released version to pin is not named in any read source.
evidence: Architecture v5 slide 23 'version 1.30+'; slide 47 'Temporal upgrade from 1.28.1'; Temporal and Drools design slide 32 note 'local stack 1.29.7, ADR-011 1.28.1'.
proposed: Pin one Temporal release of 1.30 or later in Wave 0 and record it in the Temporal Workflow and Activity Catalog v1 and in ADR-016.

title: The Kafka platform for Recovery business events is not confirmed by Enterprise Architecture and the ACE platform team
source: 22 Microservice Realignment/Recovery Workbench Architecture v5 Text Extract v1.md
section: Slides 21, 39 and 47 (decision 1, risk 'Kafka platform not ready')
description: ADR-015 places the business-event topics on the bank Kafka platform that ACE already uses, with Azure Event Hubs Premium as the fallback. Architecture v5 slide 39 lists this as decision 1 still needed from the architecture team, and slide 47 records the risk that the platform is not ready in time. No read source confirms the host, the capacity, the topic naming, the ACL model or the schema registry.
evidence: Architecture v5 slide 39 'Six decisions we need from the architecture team', item 1, owner Enterprise Architecture and the ACE platform team; slide 21 'To confirm with the ACE platform team: capacity, topic naming, ACL model, schema registry, environments'.
proposed: Confirm the Kafka host, topic naming, ACL model and schema registry in Wave 0; keep the outbox and the Event Hubs fallback until the topics exist.

title: RPO and RTO are not set in NFR Spec v3
source: 22 Microservice Realignment/Recovery Workbench Architecture v5 Text Extract v1.md
description: ADR-023 states the NFR v3 service targets, which include a screen response, a rule evaluation budget, a 60 second agent limit and 99.9% availability in business hours. RPO and RTO are not set, so the availability target cannot be tested against a recovery objective and the observability design has no recovery objective to report on.
evidence: Architecture v5 slide 48 'RPO/RTO: not yet set' and note 'NFR gap: RPO/RTO are not set in NFR Spec v3; proposed tiers'.
proposed: Set RPO and RTO per service tier in the next NFR Specification version and restate them in ADR-023.
